author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing had no head, straight antennae crossing in an X over the shell and straight leg stubs, reading as a crossed-out bug; the original shows a head carrying curved antennae, a domed shell with a centre seam and bent legs.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Head ring with antennae sweeping out, domed shell split by a seam, three bent legs per side; reads as a beetle from above.
omissions: The pronotum band (would close sub-minimum holes); the head is a small ring because a larger dome cannot keep 8 from the shoulders.
